criteria.criterion: A run whose only issues are SoldBackfillWindow and/or PriceBandCapHit completes as Completed.
criteria.plannedImplementation: ScrapeRunIssueSeverityClassifier.IsFailure returns false only for the two literal IssueType strings SoldBackfillWindow and PriceBandCapHit. ScrapeRunCompletion.DetermineStatus loads the run's ScrapeRunIssues.IssueType values and returns Completed when none of them classify as a failure.
criteria.plannedVerification: ARunWithOnlyInformationalIssuesCompletesCleanlyTests (real SQLite via IDbContextFactory, same pattern as ScrapeStoreTests/ScrapeRunReportStoreTests): seeds a run with both SoldBackfillWindow and PriceBandCapHit issue rows and asserts ScrapeRunCompletion.DetermineStatus returns Completed.

comparisonObservation.firstObservation: A run with only SoldBackfillWindow and PriceBandCapHit issue rows completes as Completed.
comparisonObservation.whenHeldValueAbsent: ARunWithAFailureIssueEndsCompletedWithErrorsTests seeds the same informational SoldBackfillWindow row plus one SearchPageFailed row and gets CompletedWithErrors instead -- proving the informational rows themselves never drive the status, only the presence of a failure-class row does.

criteria.criterion: A run with any failure-class issue, or an unknown issue type, completes as CompletedWithErrors.
criteria.plannedImplementation: ScrapeRunIssueSeverityClassifier.IsFailure returns true for every IssueType string not in its two-entry informational set, so both the six named failure types (SearchPageFailed, ItemDetailFetchFailed, ItemDetailParseFailed, SoldBackfillBudgetExhausted, SoldBackfillBandOverflow, SearchYieldedNoResults) and any future/unknown type fail closed to CompletedWithErrors.
criteria.plannedVerification: ARunWithAFailureIssueEndsCompletedWithErrorsTests seeds a mix of one informational and one named failure issue (SearchPageFailed) and asserts CompletedWithErrors. AnUnknownIssueTypeFailsSafeToCompletedWithErrorsTests seeds a single issue with an invented IssueType string not present in the classifier's set and asserts CompletedWithErrors, proving the fail-safe default.

comparisonObservation.firstObservation: A run with one unrecognised issue type ends CompletedWithErrors.
comparisonObservation.whenHeldValueAbsent: ARunWithOnlyInformationalIssuesCompletesCleanlyTests seeds only the two known informational types and ends plain Completed -- proving unknown types are not silently treated as informational by default, only the two explicitly listed strings are.

criteria.criterion: (Scope item 3, optional) Expose the class on the runs API (GET /api/jobs/{id}/runs issue objects) as a severity field (info / error).
criteria.plannedImplementation: ScrapeRunIssueView gained a trailing string Severity property. ScrapeRunViewMapper.MapIssue populates it via ScrapeRunIssueSeverityClassifier.ToSeverityLabel(issue.IssueType), which returns the literal 'info' or 'error'. GET /api/jobs/{id}/runs (Program.cs, unchanged) already serializes ScrapeRunView -> Issues -> ScrapeRunIssueView as-is, so the new field flows through automatically.
criteria.plannedVerification: ScrapeRunIssueViewExposesItsSeverityTests records one PriceBandCapHit and one SearchPageFailed issue through the real ScrapeRunReportStore.RecordIssue/GetRunsForJob path (the same path the API endpoint calls) and asserts Severity is 'info' for the former and 'error' for the latter.
materialConcerns: No dedicated Integration-project test hits GET /api/jobs/{id}/runs over HTTP to check the JSON field name/casing on the wire; ScrapeRunReportStore.GetRunsForJob is exercised directly instead, which is the only method that endpoint calls, so the model-level behaviour is covered but the wire-format assertion is not.

comparisonObservation.whenHeldValueAbsent: A SearchPageFailed issue recorded on the same run in the same test has Severity 'error' -- proving the field reflects the classifier's per-issue-type decision rather than a run-level constant.
